senses.gloss: pr. n. (v. קַרְדּוּ I) Ḳardunia, Cordyene, a district lying to the east of the river Tigris, south of Armenia.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 8:4">Targ. Y. Gen. VIII, 4</cite> <he>קרדנ׳</he> (name of a mountain).—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> (expl. <he>הרי אררט</he>, Gen. l. c.) <he>טורי ק׳</he> the mountains of Ḳardunia.—Denom. f. pl. <cite ref="S00580"><he>קוּרְדֵּנְיָיתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00580"><he>קוּרְדַּנְיָתָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Pesachim 7a">Pes. 7ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 21b">21ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ בחיטי ק׳</he> even with wheat of Cordyene (when it has become moistened, although it is very hard); Y. ib. I, 27ᶜ bot. <he>אפי׳ חטים קוּרְטַבְנִיּוֹת במדבר וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="A01275"><he>אילו</he></cite>) even with Cordyenian wheat in the desert; for would they be worth anything during the Passover (to be considered an object of value for betrothal)?
